method: Compare every frozen git blob with git hash-object of the delivery worktree. The sole changed frozen path is the explicitly scoped CI artifact-isolation step. All new delivery paths are documentation or verification artifacts.
exceptionReason: Preserve the immutable checked-in handoff outside the fresh CI output directory before any install/test step, so failed or successful CI cannot mix old sealed evidence with fresh output. Triggers, permissions, test commands and deployment scope remain unchanged.
